_comment: Zipcode config for the 59x91 BLOCK grid (235x363 spot array, 4x4 blocks).
bar_1 = X_code(14nt) + Y_code(14nt) = 28nt total, no spacer.
X encodes the 91-block column axis; Y encodes the 64-block row axis.
28 bits per axis (4-bits-per-base one-hot → 14nt DNA) comfortably encodes both axes:
X: log2(91)=6.5 bits needed; 28 bits available → very generous error correction.
Y: log2(64)=6.0 bits needed; 28 bits available → very generous error correction.
Same barcode format as 118x182 (28+8=36nt); only the bar_1 library differs.
Same bar_2 library (16 x 8nt) can be reused unchanged.
